caption: The drawing depicts a large, reddish-brown ceramic pot with a slightly flared rim and a rounded body that tapers toward the base. The pot's surface shows subtle gradients of lighter and darker shades, suggesting texture and shadows. Attached to the upper sides of the pot are two symmetrical, stylized handles shaped like abstract leaves or petals, rendered in a darker, almost purplish-brown color. Slightly above the handles, there is an indented decorative mark on the pot's surface. In the upper right corner of the drawing, a rectangular inset provides a close-up view of one of the handles, highlighting its detail and attachment to the vessel. The objects are set against a cream-colored background bordered by a faint rectangular outline, and the artist's signature "N. AnnatTea" appears at the bottom right corner of the outlined area.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
